title: release train weekly prep notes - launch readiness v1.8
content:
Agenda / purpose:
- Weekly prep for release train: v1.8 launch readiness review and go/no-go call prep. Focus areas: infra scale, runtime perf regressions, canary rollout plan, customer comms, rollback plan.

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- Current status: blocked -> more of a medium-risk launch. Two high-priority blockers (kv-cache perf regression on mixed-batch workloads; dedicated pool autoscaler bug) need mitigation or clear fallback before GO.
- Metrics to watch: p50/p95 token latency, 5xx rate, autoscaler events per hour, disk I/O on cache nodes.
- Proposed go/no-go window: Tue 2026-04-28 02:00-05:00 UTC (low traffic) with 2-hour canary then progressive rollout.

Open blockers (owners + notes):
1) KV-cache perf regression (seen after quantization change): owner: Priya Kapoor.
   - Symptoms: 15-20% p95 latency increase on mixed-batch gen (seq_len>512).
   - Repro steps: run perf-suite/kv-mixed-batch-512 with model rsw-v2-int8.
   - Mitigation path: revert quantization microchange OR enable fallback to original kernel.
   - ETA for fix: Priya estimates EOD 2026-04-23 for a patch; canary validation 26th.

2) Dedicated autoscaler race condition (scale-down sometimes drops active workers prematurely): owner: Samir Patel.
   - Impact: potential dropped requests/tracebacks during bursty traffic.
   - Short-term mitigation: extend cooldown to 6m, add pre-termination drain check.
   - PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/autoscaler/pull/678 (Samir).
   - ETA: PR ready, needs staging run 2026-04-24.

3) Console rollout: feature flagging for per-route tracing (Elena Ruiz).
   - Need to ensure flag default is off for production tenants until logging cost analysis complete.
   - Action: Elena to produce cost estimate by 2026-04-23.

4) Customer comms + beta customers: owner: Noah Kim.
   - Draft of beta notes emailed to 5 pilot customers; waiting for feedback (deadline 2026-04-24).

GO/NO-GO checklist (must all be green OR have documented fallback):
- [ ] Infra: autoscaler stable in staging with extended cooldown (owner: Samir)
- [ ] Runtime perf: p95 within +5% of baseline on staging canary (owner: Priya)
- [ ] Rollback tested: full rollback exercise completes in <30m (owner: Ashley)
- [ ] Monitoring: dashboards and alerts validated (pager+Slack runbook) (owner: Maya)
- [ ] Security/compliance: private deployment checklist signed off for any customers on Private (owner: Legal/Security)
- [ ] Customer comms: release notes + support playbook ready (owner: Noah)
- [ ] DB/migrations: no schema change scheduled; if any, migration plan reviewed (owner: Platform Eng)

Deployment plan (high-level):
1) 02:00 UTC start: smoke tests on staging, final canary chosen subset (10% traffic) -> monitor for 45m.
2) If no regressions -> increment to 50% over 30m -> monitor 60m.
3) Full rollout in waves (final 2 hours to reach 100%) with pause points.
4) If any critical alert -> immediate pause + rollback to previous model variant; run rollback playbook.

Rollback playbook (summary):
- Trigger: sustained p95 > baseline+10% for 15m OR 5xx rate spike > 0.5% OR autoscaler failures.
- Steps: 1) Pause rollout; 2) Switch routing to previous model variant (retained in model-catalog); 3) If autoscaler issue, scale up control-plane pool to absorb traffic until fix; 4) Run smoke tests and verify; 5) Communicate to stakeholders (Slack #release-train + email to customers if affected).

Monitoring & runbook links:
- Perf dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/launch-v1.8
- Alerts: pager duty schedule + slack integration (doc link above).
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/REL/v1.8+Launch+Runbook

Pre-launch validation matrix (owners & acceptance criteria):
- Load test: Pass 2x expected RPS with <2% error rate (owner: Release Eng infra)
- End-to-end latency: p95 < baseline+5% (owner: Priya)
- Canary debug logging: enabled for canary only, no extra cost to production (owner: Elena)
- Telemetry sampling: verify telemetry retention and sampling config (owner: Observability)

Action items (next steps / owners):
- Priya: push kv-cache patch to staging + run mixed-batch perf tests (due 2026-04-23).
- Samir: run autoscaler staging stress test with cooldown change + share logs (due 2026-04-24).
- Elena: finalize cost estimate for tracing flag and confirm default-off flag (due 2026-04-23).
- Noah: finalize beta communication and compile pilot feedback (due 2026-04-24).
- Maya: validate alerting thresholds and runbook steps, run a 30m on-call drill (due 2026-04-25).
- Ashley: schedule go/no-go meeting invite (stakeholders list below) and prepare rollback checklist (due 2026-04-25).

Stakeholders invited to go/no-go (proposed):
- Eng: Priya Kapoor, Samir Patel, Maya Singh, Elena Ruiz, Noah Kim
- Product: Arjun Mehta, Leah Park
- Ops/SRE: Luke Wu, Ethan Park
- CS/Support: Olivia Chen, Aisha Rahman
- Legal/Security backup: Zara Ali

Notes to self / loose thoughts:
- If kv-cache patch is risky, consider canary with older model variant that doesn't use new quantization path. Document performance trade-offs for customers.
- Confirm on-call rotations for the 8-hour post-launch window; pair an infra lead + runtime lead.
- Consider limiting the per-route tracing rollout to internal customers for first 48h to avoid cost surprises.

Meeting prep for Monday sync (2026-04-22):
- Quick status from Priya + Samir (5 min each)
- Review checklist progress and highlight any new risks (10 min)
- Confirm staging test results & final canary subset (10 min)
- Decide go/no-go meeting time and owners for broadcast (5 min)

End of notes.
plain_text_summary: Weekly prep for v1.8 launch: two high-priority blockers (kv-cache perf regression, autoscaler race) need patches and staging validation. Proposed go/no-go window Tue 2026-04-28 02:00-05:00 UTC. Checklist and owners assigned; action items due 2026-04-23 to 04-25.
